QUOTE: `PermissionPersister::save_permission` (`permission_persister.cpp:227`) appends an entry under `permissions.allow` or `permissions.deny` in the project YAML. It is a no-op if the entry is already present.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes persisting to "the project YAML" but never names config.local.yaml or contrasts it with the in-memory add_permission call.
